units.statement: Greenbaum et al. built a spatiotemporal atlas of the human maternal-fetal interface using multiplexed ion beam imaging (MIBI), documenting a shift in maternal immune compartment composition from lymphoid to myeloid cells with enrichment of tolerogenic subsets correlated with gestational age, and showing how fetal cells invade and remodel maternal uterine blood vessels while maternal immune cells promote tolerance.
